trap.label: falso cognato
trap.wrong: The assistance was mostly managers, not specialists.
trap.right: The audience was mostly managers, not specialists.
trap.why: “Assistência” em português é o público presente, mas em inglês assistance é ajuda. O público é audience.

mcq.q: The **purpose** of a talk is to...

fix.wrong: My purpose is inform the managers.
fix.right: My purpose is to inform the managers.
I want to persuade the audience.

fix.wrong: The slide limit is of ten.

rewrite.prompt: Troque assistance pelo termo correto: “The assistance liked the talk.”
Reescreva com purpose: “I want to persuade.” (My purpose is…)
Reescreva no plural: “The slide limit is low.”
